restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่ เมดิคอล แล็บ คลินิกเทคนิคการแพทย์
text:
Had my thai girlfriend ask the lab what levels of testosterone they could measure. They told me that if I told them beforehand that I am using testosterone that they can perform a test up until 10.000 NG/DL. Given that I knew it couldn't be anywhere nearly that high, we went there and made sure to explain them in thai what we discussed on the phone.
They fully understood.
In the days after I received tests that made no sense what so ever and when we called them they blamed me.
How am I at fault when all I have to do is give you my blood? I gave them my blood, fasted before for 14 hours and had a thai national do all the talking for me.

I also had to chase them for 2 weeks to get the results in the first place.

1000s of baht wasted, no apology what so ever and this lab shouldn't be rated as high as it is.
